goal: Prevent inbound peers from bypassing transaction-relay capacity limits by requesting mempool inventory
Keep nodes from serving full mempool inventory to connections not counted toward relay limits
agreement: Neutral sentiment with previous objections resolved and no explicit support yet
Concern that peers would receive unintended unfiltered announcements resolved with a test (darosior)
Objection to allowing mempool requests when relay is disabled resolved by ignoring them (gmaxwell)
Verified SPV sequencing compatibility with existing client implementations (schildbach)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it fixes an evasion of inbound transaction-relay capacity limits
Prevents uncounted peers from requesting full mempool inventory and undermining DoS defenses
